title: fix(spec): the two step-18 flow-binding D3 entries name only a text-slot hole and a CEL expression as the reads to rename
body:
Fixes #23338
Clause-②: no

Two ADR-0087 D3 semantic entries of protocol 18 still told an upgrading author to rename "a single-brace token in a value position" among the reads of a renamed variable. No protocol-18 value position reads a flow variable through a single-brace token, so this PR takes the phrase out of both `replacement` texts. It is a text-only change, following triage's direction (comment 6155971636): the card's "Wanted", as written.

Dispatched by the `domain:spec` seat 2 PM, session `session_01BRQ9Mp1yH7R1az6MaUM18H`, under its claim comment 6159719865.

## What changes

- `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.flow-binding-name-dollar-refused.ts` and `18.flow-binding-variable-dollar-name-refused.ts`: the last clause of `replacement` names a text-slot hole and a CEL expression, and nothing else. Each entry keeps its `id`, `fromVersion`, `toVersion`, `surface`, `reason`, `acceptanceCriteria` and every other field byte-identical. No schema, door, conversion or entry id changes.
- `.changeset/23338-flow-binding-d3-replacement-reads.md`: an `@objectstack/spec` patch, with the FROM → TO sentence.

| FROM | TO |
|:--|:--|
| Rename every read of the old name with it — a text-slot hole, a CEL expression, a single-brace token in a value position | Rename every read of the old name with it — a text-slot hole, a CEL expression |

The new wording is the one PR #23252 gave both entries' changesets (`22502` and `22572`, now under `.changeset/pre/`), and the one PR #23336 put in the `18.0.0-next.0` entries of `packages/spec/CHANGELOG.md`: "(a text-slot hole, a CEL expression)". The generated upgrade guide and `spec-changes.json` now say the same as those release notes.

Why it is true: S6 (`615c69604`) made every CRUD `filter` operand a value slot, and S7 (`7958bdf36`) deleted the single-brace resolver. A value slot takes a CEL value envelope or a literal, and a `{…}` token there is refused. One measured nuance is stated in the changeset, so that its sentence stays true: a CRUD `filter` operand that is one whole query placeholder (`{current_user_id}`, `{today}`) is handed on to the query engine untouched (the `filterOperand` arm of `valueSlotTemplateRefusals`, judged by `classifyFlowFilterOperandString`). That placeholder reads no flow variable, so a renamed variable has no read there.

## The grep over every step-18 entry

At base `713f23185`, over `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/**/18.*` (769 files):

1. **The card's phrase**, `git grep -n "single-brace token in a value position"` over the whole repository: exactly 2 hits, the two entries above, and both are corrected here. At head `6bf205cb8` the only hit is the FROM cell of this PR's changeset.
2. **The same idea in other words**, `git grep -n -i -E "single[- ]brace|value position|\{token\}|brace token|\{var\}|single-curly|template dialect|template token"`: 22 hits in 9 entries. Apart from the two above, none reads the token as live:
   - `18.flow-builtin-node-config-values-refused.ts` :40, :57, :86: a `{token}` in a number or boolean slot is refused as the wrong type; at a plain string key it parses and registers as a literal; `http` interpolated "once" and "interpolates nothing now". No read is claimed.
   - `18.flow-text-slot-single-brace-refused.ts` (5 hits): the text-slot refusal.
   - `18.flow-text-slot-unbound-dollar-root-refused.ts` :32, :35: "In 17.x the slot was a plain string read by the single-brace interpolator", in the past tense, and a refusal's remedy.
   - `18.flow-value-slot-template-dialect-refused.ts` (4 hits): the value-slot refusal, with the query-placeholder carve-out named.
   - `18.flow-write-node-stored-metadata-target-refused.ts` :37: a `{token}` `objectName` cannot be read as a name.
   - `18.translation-flow-screen-title-text-slot-refused.ts` (4 hits): the translated-heading refusal.
   - `18.view-filter-rule-scalar-operator-array-refused.ts` :25: a filter rule's "value position", which has nothing to do with templates.
3. **A third pass**, `brace` or `interpolat` outside the two spellings above: 29 more hits in 13 entries. Each is in the past tense, a refusal, or another dialect (`${…}` in UI action URLs, a datasource secret, dashboard documents). None names a single-brace read as live.

The step-18 rationale fragments in `registry.ts.template` carry no such sentence either. Their `single-brace` hits are refusals, plus the statement that the single-brace interpolator is deleted.

## Generated projections and pins

- **No tracked file embeds the old sentence.** At base, `git grep "Rename every read of the old name"` finds only the two entries. `registry.ts`, `spec-changes.json` and the `content/docs/protocol-upgrade/` pages are gitignored build output, so nothing was regenerated or committed.
- **The projections carry the new text, measured on this head.** `build-upgrade-guide.ts --out` and `build-spec-changes.ts --out` were written to a scratch path. The old phrase has 0 hits in each (grep exit 1). The new sentence has 2 hits in the guide and 4 in `spec-changes.json` (exit 0). In the built `dist/migrations/index.mjs` and `index.js`, the old phrase is absent (exit 1) and the new sentence has 2 hits each.
- **No test reads either `replacement` text.** `flow-bound-variable-name.test.ts` pins only these two entries' `surface`, `conversionIds` and rationale id, and `migrations.test.ts` judges the shape of every semantic entry. No new test is added for a text fix.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck`, `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `pnpm turbo run build --filter=!@objectstack/docs --concurrency=2`, under the lock: 75 successful, 75 total. This build is the prerequisite of three derived gates.
- **Derived gates.** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, gives 82 commands. Each ran with its exit code captured before any pipe.
  - First pass: 79 exited 0. 3 exited 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, nothing built yet): `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. After the full build, all three exited 0.
  - Among the 82, all exit 0: `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:upgrade-guide`, `check:spec-changes`, `check:authorable-surface`, `check:doc-authoring` and `check:nul-bytes`.
  - `--ran`: "82 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 82 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 82 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)."
- **ESLint, a measured narrowing.** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the 3 changed files. The 2 `.ts` files have 0 errors and 0 warnings. The config ignores the `.md` changeset. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`), so the diff cannot move the verdict on an untouched file.
- **No consumer sweep.** Only string values change, so no export, type or wire shape moves.
